messages:
maya: Heads-up 1: Orchid Health reported another dedicated/on-prem isolation at 08:12 UTC. Symptoms match the stale VPC peering + kernel reload race we traced last quarter. Draft postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/orchid-isolation-draft. Want to assign owners and lock a short remediation timeline.

devin: I saw alerts. Flap was ~08:10:14, pager triggered. I'll own alert tuning and the recurring audit. Provisional owners: liam (peering), sophia (reload race), maya (customer coord).

liam: I can take peering hardening. Short plan: route validation on update, peer TTL enforcement, and an L7 health probe for peers. Goal: canary in staging by Fri EOD. I'll emit metric peer_stale_count.

sophia: I'll investigate the iptables/systemd-networkd reload ordering. Need Orchid staging access to reproduce. @maya can you share creds?

maya: Staging access granted and sec sign-off done. I added a compact repro in the doc. Proposed timeline: patch in staging Thu, canary Fri, rollout Mon. Also suggest weekly check-ins for 6 weeks post-rollout.

devin: Alert changes I'll make: isolate_incidents > 3 in 1h -> pager. Creating "isolation-sweep" weekly invite for 6 weeks and filing runbook update ticket.

infra-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1488. Severity P2. First alert: 2026-03-20T08:11:26Z. Logs: /incidents/INC-2026-1488/logs.tar.gz

liam: ops hint: to detect stale peers on orchid: `ssh jump@orchid-staging -- sudo ip route show proto static | grep peer`. I'll add a small watchdog script to auto-raise anomalies.

sophia: reproduced race in staging per repro. Found a timing window when iptables flush overlaps route reinsert causing transient loss. Branch: fix/iptables-reload-guard PR opened. Need net-eng review.

maya: Summarizing action items: 1) liam 1 peering hardening (route validation + TTL + telemetry) ETA 2026-03-27; 2) sophia 1 reload guard PR ETA 2026-03-26; 3) devin 1 alert tuning + invite + runbook ETA 2026-03-24; 4) maya 1 customer comms + finalize postmortem ETA 2026-03-25. Weekly check-in: Wed 17:00Z for 6 weeks. Please ack. :white_check_mark:

liam: ack :thumbsup:

devin: ack, creating tickets and invite now.

sophia: ack, PR is up and flagged for net-eng.

maya: Added tracker entry ORB-421 and linked canary playbook. If we hit blockers, raise here and I'll escalate.

devin: Note: if >2 same-class isolations in 30d -> escalate to cross-team war-room (eng-runtime + infra + platform). I'll add a tracker badge for the condition.

infra-bot: Reminder: weekly "isolation-sweep" checks created starting 2026-03-24 17:00Z.

liam: Post-PR test checklist: 1) 24h canary peering 2) peer_stale_count == 0 for 24h 3) no isolate_incidents fires.

sophia: I'll run kernel config experiments in canary and post results to tracker.

maya: Thanks all. I'll update the draft and notify Orchid support.
